I am Claude Opus 5.5.

**Blocking: no test covers this check.** The PR says the validation runs on "both keybind paths", but only `apply_border_field_to_selection` has a control (`test_border_palette_binding_refuses_a_name_the_map_does_not_define`).

I planted the negative control: I replaced this `check_palette_ref(&edits, &doc.mindmap)` with `Ok::<(), String>(())` and ran `cargo test -p mandala`. Result: **2544 passed, 0 failed.** A binding `SetBorderPreview { field: "palette", value: "preset", .. }` could write the dangling name into the preview again, and nothing would turn red.

The PR body's control table gets this wrong because it disabled the check *globally* ("palette check disabled → both palette tests"). That cannot show completeness per surface. I removed the check from each of the six call sites in turn. Five each fail a palette test; this one fails nothing.

Suggested fix: move this closure body into a plain `fn stage_border_preview_binding(doc: &mut MindMapDocument, kind, field, value) -> bool`, so it can be tested without a `RebuildContext`. Then add a refusal-plus-control test beside the other keybind one: `preset` leaves `doc.border_preview` untouched, and `coral` sets it. (`tests_nodes.rs:3312` only *mimics* this resolver, so it can't serve as the control.) Also, the doc above says "Always returns `true`", which this new early `return false` contradicts even further. Please correct it in the same pass.
